newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hochtief, Holzmann call news conference on stakes.
newsitem.headline: Hochtief, Holzmann call news conference on stakes.

text.p: German building groups Hochtief AG and Philipp Holzmann AG on Monday called a surprise news conference for Tuesday to announce a deal aimed at giving Hochtief greater management control of its industry rival.

The two firms, which have been locked in a battle of the future control of Holzmann for over a year, said they would inform the media about plans to pool stakes totalling almost 50 percent held in Holzmann by Deutsche Bank AG and Hochtief.
Deutsche will be a co-host at the news conference, the two building groups said.
The two major shareholders in Holzmann, Germany's largest construction group, confirmed earlier on Monday they were in talks over a possible plan to pool their stakes together.

The arrangement, involving a 25.8 percent stake held by Deutsche Bank AG and a 20 percent interest held by construction group Hochtief AG, would be aimed at increasing Hochtief's management control over Holzmann.
It would also seek to sidestep resistance shown by German cartel authorities in Hochtief's two-and-a-half-year campaign to increase the size of its direct stake in Holzmann.
Hochtief said in a separate statement that it had reached a deal with Commerzbank AG annulling a sales agreement under which Hochtief bought a 10 percent stake in Holzmann.
